_: Programs that are never RECOMMENDED (shelves, evenings, stations, Surprise, Home) and stay findable by Search, Browse and their own pages: no_recommend with the reason 'racist caricature' (catalog DECISIONS 013, after Archive Watch Decision 174). Evidence only, never a hunch: each pattern names a source a reader can open that documents the program or form as racial caricature. `on` is 'series' (the series name only) or 'both' (series name or episode title). `not` exempts an episode id with its reason; `add` names one episode with its source.

amos-n-andy.why: white actors voicing Black characters in the blackface minstrel tradition; protested for its racist stereotyping

beulah.why: its caricature of a Black maid, first voiced by a white man; criticized by the NAACP

minstrel-show.why: the blackface minstrel show, a form built on racial stereotypes of Black people

mitchell-minstrels.why: the George Mitchell Minstrels, who performed in blackface

fu-manchu.why: the character as a stereotype embodying the 'Yellow Peril'

not.chrwrvo|t070322009fromsamhenrytoamosandy: a program on the history of the act (its title, From Sam 'n' Henry to Amos 'n' Andy), not a performance of it
not.raykroc|n1: an interview with Ray Kroc about discovering the act's players (its title), not a performance
